bundle: demo Discord bot 'Grinder' (throwaway, for a store-sector validation meeting)
web launch cost estimate (200 songs + stems, several user scales)

decisions.discord_interaction_notes: Midjourney-style: /mix with autocomplete over the local catalog -> finished mix posted in-channel as a playable MP3 clip + buttons (Another take, Play in voice, Leave voice). PLUS voice-channel playback like a rhythm bot. Convenience is the priority; throwaway demo, not production.
decisions.bot_name: Grinder (beta) — Prompt-DJ is the product name.
decisions.cost_scale_notes: One-time 200-song ingestion (stems) cost; then monthly at 100 / 1,000 / 10,000 active users. USD + INR (~83/USD). Lines: stem sep (Replicate), planning (Claude), storage (R2/S3), compute, DB, bandwidth.
decisions.demo_catalog_notes: Use the ~24-song local catalog for the demo bot. The 200-song figure is only for the cost estimate.
decisions.go_live_notes: Founder created the Discord application (Application ID 1535993733269684334) and the bot token during kickoff. The agent NEVER sees the token; it lives only in a founder-created gitignored .env. Invite link pre-built from the public Application ID. Morning: run Start-Grinder.bat, then /mix.

hard_constraints: No dangerous surface touched: render.py, validate.py, songs.py, storage.py, config/settings, .env*, CI, test harness.
The bot reuses the engine via its local HTTP API; the engine is not modified.
The agent never creates any .env / .env.* file (secret + dangerous glob); env vars documented in the README, the founder creates the real .env via Set-Grinder-Token.bat.
Bot token never pasted into chat, never seen by the agent.
outcome: Built + mock-tested (11 passed). NOT live-tested against Discord yet (needs the founder's token, a ~5-min morning step). Nothing merged; on branch feat/grinder-discord-bot.
